extraction.name: Arabic-Nougat: Fine-Tuning Vision Transformers for Arabic OCR and Markdown Extraction
extraction.description: A suite of OCR models for converting Arabic book pages into structured Markdown text, including three fine-tuned models and two released datasets.
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The primary training dataset arabic-img2md was created by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text. A large-scale dataset arabic-books was extracted from over 8,500 books using the authors' SOTA model.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML content from the Hindawi website; Arabic book pages; over 8,500 Arabic books.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: HTML content was scraped from Hindawi, converted to PDFs, and then Markdown text was extracted to create paired image-Markdown samples.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The dataset consisted of paired Arabic book page images and Markdown representations; 160 random unseen book pages were used as a test set. The paper does not describe additional filtering or preprocessing steps.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Markdown representations were paired with Arabic book page images to form training samples. The paper does not describe human annotation procedures; the pairs were generated from scraped HTML and extracted Markdown.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Aranizer-PBE-86k tokenizer; Flash Attention 2; torch.bfloat16 training setup; the authors' SOTA model was used to extract Arabic tokens for arabic-books.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: All models and datasets are open-sourced. The paper does not specify versioning, update schedule, maintainers, or deprecation policy.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The work aims to improve digitization and structured text extraction for underrepresented Arabic documents, supporting downstream NLP, knowledge base creation, and information retrieval.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The arabic-img2md dataset is derived from Hindawi web content and may not generalize well to other Arabic domains such as scientific, religious, or historical documents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Hallucination occurs in arabic-small-nougat; repetition issues occur in arabic-base-nougat and arabic-large-nougat; the dataset may not generalize across domains; training arabic-large-nougat requires significant computational resources; performance on multilingual or mixed-script documents was not extensively tested; highly irregular or multi-modal layouts may require additional preprocessing or adaptations.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluation of Arabic OCR and Markdown extraction models; the paper recommends arabic-base-nougat for general text extraction and arabic-large-nougat for lengthy or complex documents.
